# backend/evaluation/datasets

**Ground truth.** Maintained in two halves. Derived rows are generated by querying the frozen snapshot and are never hand-edited. Authored rows carry human-written reference answers — a model-written reference would only confirm the model's own output.

| | |
|---|---|
| `question_bank.py` | the specifications derived questions are generated from |
| `generate_ground_truth.py` | rebuilds derived rows after a reseed |
| `verify_ground_truth.py` | fails non-zero on drift |
| `question_sets/` | valuation, growth, sentiment, mixed, plus smoke and focus |

_Implementations are private. This file lists what lives here and what it is responsible for._
